about_the_game:
About:

This is a top-down third-person shooter where players take on the role of an elite assassin, carrying out missions involving stealth kills, concealment, and weapon upgrades. Trapped in the conspiracy between the Illuminati and the Crescent Party, you must navigate a path of vengeance and redemption, uncovering the dark truths of a shadowy world through bloodshed.
